description: This file defines the ContentPage class responsible for rendering HTML content pages within a documentation framework, including breadcrumb generation, page initialization, and template selection.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: A class for rendering HTML content pages with breadcrumb navigation, language detection, and template rendering.

methods.name: isHomepage
methods.description: Determines if the current page is the homepage based on parent directory and index page.

methods.name: isLanding
methods.description: Checks if the page is a landing page based on configuration and homepage status.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes page properties such as homepage status and language based on configuration and directory structure.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbTrail
methods.description: Generates breadcrumb trail data based on parent directories, supporting multilanguage structure.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Assembles page data, determines template, and renders the page content.
